name: web-search
description: Search the web using Tavily (no key needed; a key raises limits). Returns structured results: title, URL, snippet, and (for advanced depth) extracted page content. For simple lookups, one search is enough. For research tasks, call multiple times with different queries — each covering a different angle — before forming a conclusion.

optional_secrets.tavily_api_key: Raises search limits. Without it, search runs keyless: free, but capped per hour. Free key at tavily.com.
